rationale: The entry thesis of momentum pushing toward the intraday high has failed, as price has broken below the 9-EMA and is now trading below the session VWAP, indicating a shift to mean reversion. With the stock in the upper quartile of the range but losing steam and facing a significant distance to the high, the risk of further downside toward the VWAP or lower support outweighs the potential for a late-day rally.
